name: Ab Wheel Rollout
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Lie back, then curl your ribs toward your hips.
start_cue.hi: Peeche leto, phir ribs ko hips ki taraf curl karo.

good.en: Good. You curled all the way through.

fix.en: Crunch further, bring your ribs to your hips.
fix.hi: Aur crunch karo, ribs ko hips ke paas lao.

above.en: That is enough. Do not pull your back.
above.hi: Itna hi kaafi hai. Back ko kheencho mat.

below.en: Crunch further so your abs do the work.
below.hi: Aur crunch karo taaki abs kaam karein.

almost.en: Crunch further, bring your ribs to your hips.
almost.hi: Aur crunch karo, ribs ko hips ke paas lao.

good.en: Good. You opened up fully at the bottom.

fix.en: Slow the return so the abs stretch.
fix.hi: Wapas dheere aao taaki abs stretch hon.

almost.en: Slow the return so the abs stretch.
almost.hi: Wapas dheere aao taaki abs stretch hon.

fix.en: Too fast. Control the return. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Wapas aane mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

below.en: Too fast. Control the return. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Wapas aane mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
